primary-horizontal.use: Primary authenticated UI topbar; horizontal lockup without tagline.

horizontal-tagline.use: Public marketing, public verifier page, document cover sheets. Use when the tagline is readable.

horizontal-tagline-alt.use: Alternate horizontal lockup with tagline; interchangeable with horizontal-tagline.

stacked-tagline.use: Narrow surfaces where vertical stack reads better than horizontal lockup.

shield-color.use: Favicon, collapsed sidebar rail, app icon, small avatar contexts.

shield-mono-navy.use: Monochrome navy shield for minimalist contexts (print, cover sheet corners).

wordmark-navy.use: Wordmark only; use sparingly where the shield is impractical.

horizontal-mono-black.use: Monochrome black horizontal lockup for print and grayscale rendering.

horizontal-mono-white-on-navy.use: Monochrome white lockup on navy background; dark surfaces.

variants-sheet.use: Reference sheet; NOT for direct use in product chrome.

never: change the green check to any other decorative color
add gradients, shadows, glows, or ornamental chips
place the color lockup on a saturated background
describe a visual stamp or appearance signature as cryptographic assurance
